items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, rights-dependent monetization, alert expansion, and external outreach; conditional for ordinary reversible work that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Evidence: Woot public terms do not establish commercial/public redistribution rights; 0 of 4 launch-readiness legal tasks are closed; accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and security gates remain blocked; fleet compliance is technical-only with 34 pass, 14 fail, and 11 unknown. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private, keep outreach unsent, and continue only the existing read-only evidence workstream. Do not close any task without its stated evidence.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active at 0/4 closed. No task is closable on current evidence. Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required because written permission and field-level rights for storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademarks, images, prices, affiliate use, and advertising are missing; smallest action is to complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed because inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are not evidenced; smallest action is a read-only repository/deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed because deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention, and jurisdictional treatment are not evidenced; smallest action is a read-only consent/configuration capture without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed because log fields, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA coverage, incident handling, and data-request procedures are not evidenced; smallest action is a read-only operator/vendor inventory identifying counsel-required gaps.

Fleet triage: ordinary reversible growth is conditional, not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry. Compliance failures and unknowns require site-specific remediation or private/parked disposition. Complicated.work has a compliance failure and no analytics configuration; deadlymaracas.com is unreachable for compliance evidence, parked, and lacks analytics; driveford.net is parked, lacks analytics, and has an execution-owner gap. Keep those sites gated and preserve audience, traffic, revenue, attribution, security, compliance, and margin as unknown unless directly evidenced. Existing report-only readiness work may proceed only as non-production evidence work with one recorded disposition per site.

Revenue and analytics evidence does not support financial or causal claims. Amazon reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21; the commission is unattributed and must not be assigned to a site. Analytics is configured for 39 sites, with recorded GSC permission errors for arttogogh.com, girlpain.com, and searchwoot.com; do not treat unavailable sources as zero. Preserve SEO, affiliate, UX, and launch-readiness opportunities as deferred or conditional according to site-specific gates.
